_about: The Sewer under Garathorm (levels 1-18): rats that swarm to each other's squeal, wererats, the mindflayers' colony (the master mindflayer, a sub-boss), basilisks, a hag and an otyugh as elites, and the Rat King in the deep Square Lair, spitting plague and calling his swarm.

72000.name: rat king
72000.long_desc: The Rat King squats on a throne of filth, a crown of bent spoons on his matted head.
72000.description: A rat the size of a man, grey-furred and pink-eyed, his tail knotted with a dozen smaller rats' tails into a writhing mass. Plague drips from his yellow teeth, and every rat in the sewer is his subject.

phases.message: The Rat King hurls his crown aside: "My children! Feast!"

abilities.name: Plague Squall
abilities.telegraph: The Rat King rears up and screeches, and the air fills with filth!

abilities.name: Gnashing Bite
abilities.telegraph: The Rat King bares his yellow teeth at you!

abilities.name: Call of the Swarm
abilities.telegraph: The Rat King drums his tail on the floor in a rising frenzy!

795720.name: young red dragon
795720.long_desc: A young red dragon lies coiled on the scorched floorstones, smoke curling from its nostrils.
795720.description: Not yet the size of the great wyrms of legend, but far more than big enough: a dragon the length of a barge, its scales the red of iron in the forge. It found the lair under the city and made it its own. The two shapes melted into the floor were the last to argue.
795720.why: the red dragon its lair is named for

phases.message: The young red dragon rears up, fire roaring in its throat!

abilities.name: Fire Breath

abilities.name: Raking Claws
abilities.telegraph: The young red dragon rakes its claws at you!

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.telegraph: The young red dragon gathers a blaze in its chest!
